purpose: Part 2/2 of verified hard-tail 18-record item effect batch 019; together these files contain exactly 18 reviewed records with complete captured mechanics.

items/raptor-arrow-609.name: Raptor Arrow [Relic]
items/raptor-arrow-609.effectSummary: For a neutral-good, lawful-good, chaotic-good, or neutral user, the ammunition functions as a +1 arrow and returns at the beginning of the round after it is fired, restringing itself on the bow instead of being destroyed. With the relic connection to Ehlonna, it also gains bane against the targeted foe.

items/ruby-blade-641.name: Ruby Blade [Relic]
items/ruby-blade-641.effectSummary: For a lawful-evil, lawful-neutral, lawful-good, or neutral wielder, the blade functions as a +1 axiomatic dagger. With the relic connection to Wee Jas, a wielder who can rebuke undead counts as 4 levels higher for bolstering, rebuking, or commanding undead and can activate the blade once per day to produce status.

items/sand-painting.name: Sand Painting
items/sand-painting.effectSummary: A sand painting requires DC 15 Craft (painting or sculpture) and is consumed on use. The Mandala of Peace creates a 10-foot-radius lesser globe of invulnerability for 12 rounds and silence for 12 minutes; Travelers' Oasis takes 5 minutes to pour over up to 400 square feet and creates a shaded oasis for 24 hours with enough food and water for 36 Medium or 12 Large creatures.

items/staff-power-328.name: Staff of Power
items/staff-power-328.effectSummary: The staff grants +2 luck to AC and saving throws and functions as a +2 quarterstaff; spending 1 charge as a free action lets it deal double damage for 1 round, or triple on a critical hit. Deliberately breaking it produces a retributive strike whose damage scales with remaining charges and distance, Reflex DC 17 half, with a 50% chance the breaker travels to another plane and otherwise is destroyed; once charges are exhausted it remains a +2 quarterstaff.

items/tabard-great-crusade-636.name: Tabard of the Great Crusade [Relic]
items/tabard-great-crusade-636.effectSummary: For a lawful-neutral, lawful-good, lawful-evil, or neutral wearer, the tabard continuously grants the wearer and allies within 20 feet +1 morale on saving throws. With the relic connection to St. Cuthbert, the wearer gains damage reduction 5/evil, and once per day an ally can grasp the hem as a move action to receive heal.

items/tome-stilled-tongue-640.name: Tome of the Stilled Tongue [Relic]
items/tome-stilled-tongue-640.effectSummary: For a neutral-evil, chaotic-evil, lawful-evil, or neutral reader, the tome gives full instructions for creating a lich's phylactery and contains 500 blank spell pages functioning like Boccob's blessed book. With the relic connection to Vecna, once per day 1 hour of exercises grants +1 effective caster level for all spells for 24 hours while reducing the reader's normal hit-point maximum by 1 per character level for that duration.

items/vestments-of-ebonsilk-625.name: Vestments of Ebonsilk [Relic]
items/vestments-of-ebonsilk-625.effectSummary: For a chaotic-evil, neutral-evil, or chaotic-neutral wearer, the vestments grant +2 resistance on saving throws. With the relic connection to Lolth, they also grant continuous spider climb; with the stronger qualification they additionally grant continuous freedom of movement.

items/yragerne-signet.name: Yragerne Signet
items/yragerne-signet.effectSummary: The ring continuously provides protection from evil and protection from good. Once per day the wearer can turn the signet facedown to activate death ward.

items/wind-pipe.name: Wind Pipe
items/wind-pipe.effectSummary: When activated while its intake is surrounded by air, the pipe produces airflow equivalent to a moderate wind through itself and any attached tubing. It magically circulates air even into an enclosed space with no outlet.
